name: You do not have to figure it out alone
subject: What actually happens in a counselling session?
html:
DISPELLING YOUR CLOUDS OF DOUBT

You do not have to figure it out alone

Hello {{first_name}},

A career conversation begins with you: your questions, circumstances and what matters to you. Your counsellor helps you explore options and agree on a practical next step.

You can review counsellor profiles and available times before booking. There is no promise of an instant answer—just space to think with someone who listens.

Explore counselling

Separate what you know from what you need to find out. Write down one unanswered question, then identify one person or reliable source that can help you answer it this week.
